blockers.requiredResolution: Restore normal read-only local database access and compare any supplied mapping against current Species/Breed rows.

notes: Historical local validation snapshots were used only to enumerate candidate ambiguity and were not treated as current authority.
Forty-six of the 72 controlled groups contain multiple candidate Species in the historical snapshot; every group contains at least two candidate Breeds.
No equal split, first match, all-group-members allocation, silent rounding, population event, database write, or Notion mutation occurred.
